jobs.descriptionHtml:
Terra AI is building a new category at the intersection of artificial intelligence, geoscience, and critical resource development.

As global demand for copper, lithium, nickel, rare earth elements, geothermal energy, and other strategic resources accelerates, the mining and subsurface industries face a growing challenge: traditional exploration methods remain slow, expensive, and highly uncertain. Terra AI was founded to help solve this problem by redefining how critical resources are discovered, evaluated, and developed.

By combining advanced machine learning, probabilistic modeling, and deep geoscience expertise, Terra AI helps exploration and mining companies make faster, more informed subsurface decisions with greater confidence and capital efficiency. The company’s platform integrates geological, geophysical, and drilling data into intelligent systems designed to improve targeting accuracy, accelerate discovery timelines, and reduce exploration risk.

Backed by Khosla Ventures, BHP, and Rio Tinto, Terra AI works with industry leaders to bring a more informed, data-driven approach to critical resource development.

Terra AI’s mission is to define the new global standard for data-driven critical resource development — breaking the cost and time curve required to support electrification, energy security, and the global energy transition.

The company operates with a strong partnership mentality, combining technical rigor, candid communication, continual learning, and environmental stewardship to help modern exploration teams solve some of the world’s most important resource challenges.

Who you are

You’re a deep learning engineer or scientist who loves building new models, not just applying existing ones. You’re comfortable working from first principles, experimenting with architectures, training large models, and learning from results that don’t always behave as expected.

You bring deep PyTorch expertise, strong software engineering habits, and the judgment to turn research ideas into reliable experiments. You care about the quality of training data as much as the sophistication of the model, and you enjoy collaborating with people whose expertise extends beyond machine learning.

You’re excited by the opportunity to apply generative AI to a genuinely difficult physical-world problem: understanding the geology we cannot directly see. Prior geoscience experience is welcome, but curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.

What you’ll do

Terra AI is developing generative models that produce three-dimensional geological representations conditioned on geophysical surveys, borehole measurements, and other physical observations. Like image-generation systems that produce different plausible images from a prompt, our models aim to produce plausible views of the subsurface consistent with the evidence available.

The goal is not to pretend we know exactly what lies underground. It is to capture both what we know and what remains uncertain, giving exploration teams a stronger foundation for deciding where and how to investigate critical resources.

In this role, you’ll lead the development of these models from architecture and training through evaluation and adaptation to real projects. You’ll work closely with other AI researchers, engineers, geoscientists, and project teams to connect novel modeling approaches with consequential real-world decisions.

Core responsibilities

  • Design, implement, train, evaluate, and iterate on diffusion models that generate 3D geological models.

  • Develop approaches to condition model outputs on geophysical surveys, borehole measurements, and other physical observations.

  • Shape synthetic-data generation and data-curation approaches to improve model quality, robustness, and generalization.

  • Establish rigorous experiments, evaluation methods, and reproducible training workflows to understand model performance and limitations.

  • Adapt generative modeling approaches to real-world projects in close collaboration with geoscience and delivery teams.

  • Build maintainable, well-tested model code and contribute to the engineering foundations needed for continued experimentation and deployment.

Qualifications

Required

  • Extensive hands-on PyTorch experience, including custom modules, training optimization, and debugging complex or large-scale models.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and training substantial deep learning architectures from scratch.

  • Strong data-curation skills, including creating, cleaning, validating, and maintaining datasets for machine learning.

  • Solid software engineering and system-design fundamentals, including version control, testing, code optimization, scalability, and maintainability.

Nice to have

  • Experience with generative architectures, especially diffusion models and posterior sampling methods.

  • Experience developing and training transformer architectures, particularly for 3D or other structured data.

  • Experience scaling model training across multi-GPU systems or large GPU clusters, including distributed training optimization.

  • Experience managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure for machine learning workloads.

  • We recognize that exceptional candidates come from a range of research, engineering, and scientific backgrounds. If this work excites you and your experience aligns with the spirit of the role, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every preferred qualification.

Compensation & Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is $255,000-275,000. Actual compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, location, and other job-related factors. This role is eligible for equity and Terra AI’s benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and a 401(k) with company match. Any additional incentive compensation will be communicated separately. Applications may be submitted through the job posting; the application closing date will be provided when the role is published.

We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, reproductive health decision-making, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The company operates with a strong partnership mentality, combining technical rigor, candid communication, continual learning, and environmental stewardship to help modern exploration teams solve some of the world’s most important resource challenges.

Who you are

You’re an engineering leader and a builder. You have taken technically novel ideas beyond the prototype stage and turned them into dependable systems that real teams and customers can use. You know the difference between demonstrating a research result and engineering a capability that is reproducible, maintainable, and ready to scale.

You bring deep software and systems architecture judgment, strong AI/ML fluency, and the ability to work alongside research scientists without needing to be a frontier-AI researcher yourself. You can tell when a research capability is ready to engineer, when more experimentation is needed, and where engineering feedback can sharpen the next research priorities.

You’re equally comfortable reviewing an architecture, debating a model-performance tradeoff, and recruiting the engineers who will build the system. You have built teams and technical practices rather than only inherited mature organizations, and you know how to create discipline without burying a fast-moving team in process.

Most importantly, you want to build. The opportunity to establish the engineering function between Research and Product excites you precisely because the architecture, standards, team, and operating model are still taking shape.

What you’ll do

Terra AI has a strong research practice developing novel models and algorithms, and a Product and Platform organization that turns mature capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows. We are looking for a VP of Engineering to build the critical function between them: translating promising research prototypes into robust, reusable backend technology that Product can confidently integrate and scale.

You’ll own the engineering realization of Terra AI’s core technology. That means shaping solution architectures, choosing interfaces and abstractions, developing reusable technical primitives, and making emerging capabilities reproducible, testable, performant, observable, maintainable, and economically operable. You’ll also help determine which problems belong in research and which are ready for disciplined engineering execution.

This is both a technical and organizational leadership role. You’ll personally shape early architecture decisions, recruit exceptional engineers, establish thoughtful design and delivery practices, and create strong working relationships with Research, Product, and Platform. Over time, you’ll develop leaders and a team that can mature new technologies repeatedly without relying on individual heroics.

Success here means creating an engineering capability, not simply managing a delivery queue. You’ll balance technical ambition with reliability, speed, and cost while helping frontier research become technology that Terra AI and its customers can depend on.

Core responsibilities

  • Build Terra AI’s technology-development organization, including early hiring, team design, leadership development, operating cadence, and clear interfaces with Research and Product

  • Own software and systems architecture for research-derived capabilities, including backend decomposition, APIs, data flows, abstractions, interfaces, and reusable technical components

  • Create a repeatable research-to-engineering maturation process with clear readiness criteria, technical milestones, validation, testing, documentation, and release standards

  • Establish engineering rigor in benchmarking, automated testing, observability, failure-mode characterization, versioning, reliability, and maintainability

  • Make pragmatic technical and economic tradeoffs across model quality, latency, compute, data requirements, deployment complexity, scalability, and ongoing operating cost

  • Determine which capabilities should become reusable platform primitives and which should remain project-specific, avoiding unnecessary bespoke systems

  • Translate uncertain research results into executable engineering programs with owners, dependencies, risks, milestones, and technical exit criteria without imposing false certainty on R&D

  • Partner closely with research leaders to surface engineering constraints, inform research priorities, and identify the advances that unlock the most valuable next capabilities

  • Partner with Product and Platform to define clear technical contracts and delivery standards so engineered capabilities can be integrated into enterprise products without rebuilding their foundations

  • Remain a hands-on technical executive through architecture reviews, design decisions, technical mentorship, and engineering standards while building a durable leadership bench

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience personally maturing novel technical, algorithmic, or scientific capabilities from research or early prototype into robust engineered systems deployed in real-world environments

  • A track record of building a meaningful engineering function, including recruiting, team design, management practices, technical processes, and developing engineering leaders

  • Deep software and systems architecture judgment across backend services, computational systems, interfaces, modularity, performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • Experience working effectively at the boundary between research scientists or advanced algorithm teams and product engineering organizations

  • Strong AI/ML fluency, including probabilistic outputs, model limitations, training and inference constraints, and the practical challenges of deploying novel models; a research doctorate is not required

  • Experience with technically novel scientific or physical-world systems—such as robotics, autonomy, simulation, computational biology, scientific AI, or advanced modeling—is strongly preferred

  • Evidence of helping a technical capability and its supporting organization evolve through early versions rather than joining only after the system was mature

  • Executive-level cross-functional communication and judgment, with the ability to collaborate credibly with Research, Product, Platform, customers, and technical partners

  • Strong talent judgment and experience hiring engineers across ML systems, scientific computing, algorithmic software, data-intensive backend systems, or related disciplines

  • A pragmatic, low-ego approach to ambiguity, technical quality, collaboration, and ownership

  • This is a full-time hybrid position based in Redwood City, California. Team members work in the office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, with remote work on Tuesday and Thursday.

Compensation & Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is $300,000–$400,000. Actual compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, location, and other job-related factors. This role is eligible for equity and Terra AI’s benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and a 401(k) with company match. Applications may be submitted through the job posting; the application closing date will be provided when the role is published.

Terra AI is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, reproductive health decision-making, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

We’re committed to building a workplace where people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. Terra AI also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Terra AI is building a new category at the intersection of artificial intelligence, geoscience, and critical resource development.

As global demand for copper, lithium, nickel, rare earth elements, geothermal energy, and other strategic resources accelerates, the mining and subsurface industries face a growing challenge: traditional exploration methods remain slow, expensive, and highly uncertain. Terra AI was founded to help solve this problem by redefining how critical resources are discovered, evaluated, and developed.

By combining advanced machine learning, probabilistic modeling, and deep geoscience expertise, Terra AI helps exploration and mining companies make faster, more informed subsurface decisions with greater confidence and capital efficiency. The company’s platform integrates geological, geophysical, and drilling data into intelligent systems designed to improve targeting accuracy, accelerate discovery timelines, and reduce exploration risk.

Backed by Khosla Ventures, BHP, and Rio Tinto, Terra AI works with industry leaders to bring a more informed, data-driven approach to critical resource development.

Terra AI’s mission is to define the new global standard for data-driven critical resource development — breaking the cost and time curve required to support electrification, energy security, and the global energy transition.

The company operates with a strong partnership mentality, combining technical rigor, candid communication, continual learning, and environmental stewardship to help modern exploration teams solve some of the world’s most important resource challenges.

Who you are

You’re a seasoned project manager who’s comfortable learning as you go. Experience has taught you what good looks like, where projects tend to break down, and when a little structure can prevent a lot of pain later.

Technical complexity doesn’t intimidate you. You’ve worked closely with scientists and engineers and can absorb complicated information deeply enough to ask good questions, connect the dots, and help teams make sound decisions. You know when a project needs flexibility and room to move—and when it’s time to bring in more structure, process, or discipline.

You are calm under pressure, and in front of high-value customers. You communicate clearly, exercise good judgment, own mistakes when they happen, and help create an environment where others can do the same.

Strong written and visual communication is part of the craft. You can write a paragraph at least as good as this one without the help of an LLM, and you have the editorial judgment to know when a document or slide deck is genuinely ready to present—or when it still needs another pass.

What you’ll do

This role sits at the center of our customer engagements, bringing together teams of geoscientists, software engineers, and AI/ML engineers to solve complex problems in projects that run for a few months at a time. The work is highly collaborative and varied—from early assessment and scoping through data review and processing, development of code and configurations, machine learning, and ultimately validating and tuning the results.

You will establish yourself as a trusted presence with our customers. Our projects involve high-value relationships around the world, with conversations happening both in person and remotely across time zones. Clear communication matters here, whether that means translating complex technical work for a broader audience, helping a teammate sharpen a presentation, or making sure everyone leaves a conversation with the same understanding of what comes next.

Keeping our projects moving takes equal parts organization, judgment, and curiosity. There are schedules and checklists to manage, decisions to make, changes to navigate, and moments when leadership needs to weigh in. But some of the most important contributions are less procedural: asking the question that helps a team see a problem differently, creating space for a better idea to emerge, helping people through an obstacle, and making sure great work gets recognized when the team succeeds.

We’ve built tools and processes to support this work, but we don’t consider any of them finished. There’s plenty of room to improve what exists, challenge how we do things today, and help build what comes next.

Core responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary point of contact across multiple overlapping client projects, owning day-to-day project management and helping ensure successful delivery

  • Set and manage clear expectations with customers and internal teams throughout each engagement

  • Build and maintain project plans covering scope, timelines, milestones, risks, decisions, and completion status

  • Keep important information, decisions, and action items, from falling through the cracks, and make sure commitments are met

  • Track project health and prioritize using both metrics and your expert judgment

  • Help improve the playbooks, tools, and templates that allow us to run more client engagements in parallel without sacrificing quality

  • Identify and manage risks and issues: bring the right people together to resolve them, and escalate thoughtfully when needed

  • Plan and facilitate effective internal and customer meetings, with clear agendas, decisions, and next steps

  • Create clear, polished customer-facing materials and help technical team members communicate their work effectively

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in project management, technical program management, implementation, professional services, or a similar role

  • Experience in a rapidly scaling startup environment is a strong plus

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, ideally delivering software products or services to demanding clients

  • Demonstrated ability to work closely with scientists and engineers, understanding enough underlying technology to ask good questions and drive great decisions

  • Experience with software, AI/ML, earth science, physics, or statistical analysis is a plus, but we don’t expect expertise across all of them

  • Strong judgment around when to introduce structure and process, and when flexibility is the better answer

  • A solutions-oriented mindset and a track record of navigating ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex projects

  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Multilingual communication skills (strong English required, Spanish is a strong plus)

  • Hybrid work environment at our Redwood City headquarters is preferred; we will consider a remote first role for well qualified candidates residing in the United States, Canada, or Mexico.

  • All candidates must be legally authorized to live and work, without visa sponsorship, in The United States, Canada, or Mexico.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this position $185,000-225,000 annually. Actual compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, and other job-related factors. This position is also eligible for equity and Terra AI’s comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and a 401(k) with company match.

Terra AI is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, reproductive health decision-making, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

We’re committed to building a workplace where people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. Terra AI also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Terra AI is building a new category at the intersection of artificial intelligence, geoscience, and critical resource development.

As global demand for copper, lithium, nickel, rare earth elements, geothermal energy, and other strategic resources accelerates, the mining and subsurface industries face a growing challenge: traditional exploration methods remain slow, expensive, and highly uncertain. Terra AI was founded to help solve this problem by redefining how critical resources are discovered, evaluated, and developed.

Backed by Khosla Ventures, BHP, and Rio Tinto, Terra AI works with industry leaders to bring a more informed, data-driven approach to critical resource development.

Terra AI’s mission is to define the new global standard for data-driven critical resource development — breaking the cost and time curve required to support electrification, energy security, and the global energy transition.

The company operates with a strong partnership mentality, combining technical rigor, candid communication, continual learning, and environmental stewardship to help modern exploration teams solve some of the world’s most important resource challenges.

Who you are

You don’t need to be a geoscientist, but you’re curious about the subsurface and excited by the prospect of combining differentiated technical intelligence with disciplined investing.

You’re an investor and a builder. You know how capital moves through the natural resources industry, what makes an opportunity investable, and how to earn the trust of the people who provide it. You’ve raised capital, evaluated investments, and helped turn conviction into transactions—not just advised from the sidelines.

You’re equally comfortable developing an investment thesis and getting into the details of a deal. You can assess risk, structure an investment, challenge assumptions in a financial model, and explain a complicated opportunity clearly to an investment committee or prospective capital partner.

Mining, critical minerals, energy, and other real-asset markets interest you because you understand both their potential and their complexity.

Most importantly, you want to build. You’re energized by the opportunity to help create an investment platform rather than inherit an established fund, and you bring the relationships, judgment, and hands-on approach to make that ambition credible.

What you’ll do

Terra AI is developing an investment capability alongside its technology and geoscience business. We already have a robust pipeline of potential investments emerging from our existing work and industry relationships. We’re looking for a founding investment leader to turn that opportunity into a disciplined, scalable platform—helping define where we invest, how we structure transactions, and how we attract the capital and partners needed to execute.

You’ll work closely with Terra AI’s leadership and technical teams to translate probabilistic subsurface insight into compelling investment opportunities. Our approach is designed to assess potential upside alongside geological and execution risk, helping us determine where capital can have the greatest impact. You’ll shape the investment strategy, evaluate and advance an existing opportunity pipeline, develop new opportunities, and lead conversations with potential limited partners, co-investors, and strategic capital partners.

The platform is still being built. Fund structure, investment vehicles, governance, and operating processes will need thoughtful development in partnership with leadership and external advisors. You’ll help establish the right foundations without importing unnecessary bureaucracy or assuming that yesterday’s investment playbook is the only way forward.

Success will require both strategic perspective and personal execution. In the early days, you’ll be the person building the model, making the introduction, evaluating the asset, and moving the transaction forward. Over time, you’ll help determine what team, systems, and partnerships the platform needs to scale.

Core responsibilities

  • Develop and refine Terra AI’s investment thesis, mandate, portfolio construction approach, and capital deployment strategy

  • Lead capital formation and fundraising efforts, including investor targeting, relationship development, presentations, diligence, and closing processes

  • Build the investment team and supporting infrastructure as the strategy and opportunity set mature

  • Own financial analysis, valuation, investment memos, risk assessment, deal structuring, and investment recommendations

  • Partner with Terra AI’s geoscience and technical teams to incorporate probabilistic assessments of geological uncertainty, upside, and risk into investment diligence and decision-making

  • Help design appropriate investment vehicles, governance, reporting, and investment committee processes alongside leadership, legal counsel, and external advisors

  • Establish a disciplined approach to portfolio monitoring, investor communications, and performance reporting as the platform develops

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in principal investing, private equity, natural resources investing, investment banking, asset management, or a closely related capital markets role

  • Track record of originating, evaluating, structuring, and executing investments or transactions, with clear personal ownership of outcomes

  • Investment experience in mining, metals, critical minerals, oil and gas, energy, or other natural resources is strongly preferred

  • Strong financial modeling, valuation, due diligence, negotiation, and investment judgment

  • Ability to move comfortably between high-level fundraising strategy and hands-on deal execution in an early-stage environment

  • Experience launching a fund, investment strategy, new investment vertical, or similarly entrepreneurial platform is a significant plus

  • Credibility with institutional capital providers and senior industry counterparties; an established network is highly valued

  • Curiosity about geoscience, AI, and data-driven investment approaches; direct technical expertise is welcome but not required

  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong integrity, and sound judgment in uncertain or high-stakes situations

  • Location and work arrangement will be discussed with qualified candidates.

Compensation & Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is $225,000-300,000. These figures represent a base salary, total compensation will include a mixture of company equity, as well as other mechanisms.

Actual compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, location, and other job-related factors. This role is eligible for equity and Terra AI’s benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, FSA, and a 401(k) with company match. Additional incentive compensation, if any, will be communicated separately. Applications may be submitted through the job posting; the application closing date will be provided when the role is published.

Terra AI is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, reproductive health decision-making, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

We’re committed to building a workplace where people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. Terra AI also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.
